title: 携号转网：换运营商怎么说？
summary: 换运营商但保留老号码：问转网流程、确认费用，新卡激活全程英语。

featuredPhrase.en: I want to switch to T-Mobile.

phrases.en: I want to switch to T-Mobile.
Can I keep my old number?
phrases.zh: 我能保留原来的号码吗？

phrases.en: How long does the transfer take?
Do I need a new SIM card?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Hi, I want to switch to T-Mobile from Verizon.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我想从 Verizon 转到 T-Mobile。

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.en: Welcome! Would you like to keep your old number?
dialogue.zh: 欢迎！想保留原来的号码吗？

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Yes, can I keep my old number?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.en: Of course, it's free. Is there a switching fee? No, we waive it this month.
dialogue.zh: 当然，免费。这个月转网手续费也免了。

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Great. How long does the transfer take?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.en: Usually a few hours. I'll activate your eSIM now.
dialogue.zh: 一般几小时，现在就给你激活电子卡。
